info.name: SIMS API
info.description: Generated from the OpenAPI spec. Run "0. Sign in" first, then any request. "Role checks" confirms a worker token gets 403 on staff and admin routes.

item.name: Sign in as worker (for role checks)

exec: pm.test('A worker token is refused (403)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('A worker token is refused (403)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: POST /auth/login - Sign in. Returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie
POST /auth/refresh - Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token

request.description: No authentication. Needs the httpOnly refreshToken cookie.

item.name: POST /auth/logout - Sign out and revoke the refresh token
PATCH /users/{id} - Change a user's name, role or active flag
POST /users/{id}/reset-password - Set a new password and revoke sessions
GET /audit-logs - Who changed what (field names only, never values)
GET /machines/downtime-summary - Downtime per machine over the last N days

query.description: Number of whole factory days, 1 to 90, default 7

item.name: DELETE /machines/{id} - Delete a machine and its logs
PATCH /machines/{id}/status - Change status. Writes the downtime log, raises or resolves alerts, flags bottlen

query.description: true to show only items below their reorder level

item.name: GET /inventory/low-stock - Items below their reorder level
POST /inventory/{id}/transactions - Stock in, out or adjust. Atomic: stock can never go negative
POST /workers - Create a worker and their login
GET /workers/me - The signed-in worker's own profile
DELETE /workers/{id} - Deactivate a worker (history is kept)
DELETE /shifts/{id} - Delete a shift with no active workers
POST /attendance/check-in - Check in. Late after the shift start plus 15 minutes

request.description: Role: worker (uses their own worker profile).
Role: worker (uses their own worker profile).

item.name: GET /attendance - Attendance for a day or range. Workers only ever see their own
GET /attendance/summary - Present, late and absent counts for a day
GET /tasks - List tasks. Workers only see their own
PATCH /tasks/{id}/status - Move a task. Workers may only change their own
GET /orders - List production orders. Workers only see orders linked to their tasks
POST /orders - Create an order, optionally with the materials it uses
PATCH /orders/{id} - Edit an order that is not completed
DELETE /orders/{id} - Delete an order that is not in progress
PATCH /orders/{id}/status - Move forward only: pending, in_progress, completed. Starting needs every machine a
PATCH /orders/{id}/progress - Record total units produced so far
GET /analytics/downtime - Downtime per day, machine and reason

query.description: Number of whole factory days, 1 to 90, default 7

item.name: GET /analytics/production-output - Units produced per day and product

query.description: Number of whole factory days, 1 to 90, default 7

item.name: GET /analytics/stock-trends - Stock movement and end-of-day levels

query.description: Number of whole factory days, 1 to 90, default 7

item.name: POST /machines/{machineId}/assess-risk - Gemini condition assessment. Readings come from the database, never t

request.description: Roles: admin, manager. Returns 503 until GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL are set. A repeat within 15 minutes returns the saved assessment with reused: true.

item.name: GET /ai/status - Whether the AI provider is configured
POST /ai/ask - Ask the analyst a question about operations

request.description: Roles: admin, manager. timeRange is { preset } (TODAY, YESTERDAY, THIS_WEEK, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS), or { startDate, endDate } as YYYY-MM-DD in the factory timezone (inclusive, at most 92 days), or { start, end } as ISO instants. Omitted means the last 7 days.

item.name: GET /ai/weekly-summary - Weekly summary written from calculated figures, cached for 6 hours
POST /machines/{machineId}/ml-predict - Score a machine with the trained statistical model. Inputs come from t

request.description: Roles: admin, manager. Returns { risk: Low|Medium|High, probability, topFactors, warnings, modelVersion, dataSource }. 422 names any missing input; 503 when the model service is off or down (the rest of the API is unaffected). Trained on synthetic data: probabilities are calibrated inside that synthetic world only. High raises one warning alert per machine.

item.name: GET /machines/{machineId}/ml-predictions - Saved model scores, newest first
GET /ml/status - Whether the model service is enabled and reachable, with its version, held-out metrics and li
POST /ml/rescore - Score every machine now (also runs hourly). Stops at the first outage
POST /simulate/start - Start a background simulation (stops itself after 30 minutes)
